name: She Looks So Perfect
source:
She Looks So Perfect is a short story about mutual fascination, internal struggles, and the search for connection through physical intimacy. Come along as the two main characters, a dhole and an otter, meet on a dating app for the first time and test the waters of their connection throughout the course of a day.

[From [url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/she-looks-so-perfect]Itch.io[/url]]
